hook: SFQ pulses can steer a fluxonium qubit at over 99.99% fidelity, in simulation.
summary: Pulses from superconducting digital circuits, designed for transmons, work poorly on low-frequency fluxonium qubits. The authors propose two pulse protocols, one using flux-channel pulse packets and one mixing flux and charge pulses, and test them in multilevel simulations. Results are simulation only, with no hardware demonstration.
title: High-Speed Control of a Fluxonium Qubit via Picosecond Pulses from Josephson Digital Circuits
